params.caption: 🖥️ Silicon Motion shows off its PCIe 6.0 SSD controller Silicon Motion demoed the SM8466, its PCIe 6.0 SSD controller, which has now taped out. Samples are said to be imminent, the chip promises better quality of service, and drives using it are expected to reach the market in 2027–2028. 🕒 Nov 19, 2026 · 15:00 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Tom's Hardware ⚡ React if you want PCIe 6.0 speeds · 💬 Still on PCIe 4.0 or already on 5.0? #PCIe6 #SSD #SiliconMotion #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
